thingKinds.name: Place
thingKinds.about: Any place. Add fields to a place as you need them; kinds and templates come later.

linkKinds.name: in
linkKinds.about: Containment: a place inside a larger place, one at a time.

linkKinds.name: in area
linkKinds.about: A place in a group: many groups at once, overlaps allowed.

linkKinds.name: adjacent to
linkKinds.about: A plain connection: two places that touch or sit side by side. It carries nothing and holds nothing (world-structure §4: adjacency without travel).
